description: I was eating chocolate and feeling guilty about it.
clarification: Just that it is bad for me and I am letting my guard down, I guess.
rationale: An exception plus letting the guard down should make standards-collapse eligible as a hypothesis. Broader collapse remains unconfirmed.

description: I was eating chocolate and feeling guilty about it. What went through my mind was that it is bad for me and I am letting my guard down, I guess.
rationale: The reported situation and meaning combined into one input; P0065 remains a hypothesis because broader collapse is not stated.

description: I enjoyed a treat but it feels like I am letting my guard down with my rules.
rationale: Indirect idiomatic cue; no explicit statement that all standards will collapse is required for a hypothesis.

description: I want to stop checking one small task tonight, but giving myself that exception feels like the beginning of a slippery slope.
rationale: A non-food exception/control case; several vigilance or standards hypotheses can be useful.

description: I hide how much I prepare because people might call me a try-hard if they saw.
rationale: Recognition of socially risky visible effort, without inventing envy or childhood causes.

description: One difficult afternoon makes the last month of progress feel like it never happened.
rationale: A contextual lapse can connect to invalidated progress.

description: Part of me thinks staying worried is how I keep myself ready for anything.
rationale: An expressed instrumental belief about worry.

description: I checked the ingredients because this food contains an allergen I have a confirmed allergy to. I enjoy other foods and I do not take this as a judgment about myself or my self-control.
rationale: A stated practical health constraint with explicit scope; do not manufacture a limiting rule.

description: I have not learned this spreadsheet function yet, so I booked a lesson. I expect practice will help and this says nothing about my overall ability.
rationale: A bounded skill gap with an adaptive appraisal, not global incompetence.

description: I feel a bit low today. I cannot identify a particular situation or thought.
rationale: An isolated feeling supplies no specific candidate bridge.
